components.name: Tracking Strip
components.description: Signature: five stops on one rule, solid where reached, dotted ahead; current beats blue, held is an orange diamond.
components.css: .ds-track { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); font-family: Archivo, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-track li { position: relative; padding-top: 22px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; font-stretch: 80%; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #5b5348); } .ds-track li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 0; left: 0; width: 14px; height: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #141414); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--label, #fff); } .ds-track li::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 14px; right: 0; height: 2px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink, #141414) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); opacity: .55; } .ds-track li:last-child::after { display: none; } .ds-track li.done { color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-track li.done::before { background: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-track li.done::after { background: var(--ink, #141414); opacity: 1; } .ds-track li.hold { color: var(--attn-t, #a8430a); } .ds-track li.hold::before { border-color: var(--attn, #e5641a); background: var(--attn, #e5641a); border-radius: 1px; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(.86); }

narrative.overview:
Every request is a parcel. It sits on kraft board, its label is white thermal stock boxed in a heavy black rule, and it is tracked stop by stop (Agent, Build, Test, Verify, Deploy) until production runs its commit. The header is a thermal-black band where each runner is a fixed plate with its worker slots shown as a visible budget. The world is a shipping dock, not an admin console: dense, ruled, legible at arm's length on a phone.

One family carries everything. Archivo, self-hosted as a variable font with a width axis, is squeezed to condensed widths for routing numbers, the wordmark, section heads, stickers and stop names, and runs at normal width for body copy. Monospace appears only where the content is machine text: hashes, logs, diffs, commands. State is a handling sticker: a color, a shape and a word, never color alone.

Both themes follow the device. Dark is the same dock at night: dark corrugated brown ground, labels in a lighter brown stock, rules softened to a warm grey, the band near-black, sticker colors lifted for contrast. The grey admin list with one blue accent and status pills is the explicit rejection.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft ground, white labels, 2px black rules, no shadows, square corners.
One variable family, Archivo, with width doing the hierarchy work.
Four state colors as stickers, each paired with a fixed shape and a word.
The five-stop tracking strip as the signature; stops sit at the same x in every row.
44px targets everywhere; no JavaScript required for any of it.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: A state color appears only as a state: sticker fill, a state word, a track stop, an alert mark, or a confirm panel tint. Every use carries its shape and its word.

rules.name: The Two Stocks Rule
rules.body: Content lives on label stock; kraft holds only section heads, counts and the empty-state outline. Never put readable content blocks directly on kraft.

rules.name: The Width-Is-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reach for the width axis before size: anything that names, routes or labels is condensed and uppercase; anything a person reads as sentences is normal width and sentence case.

rules.name: The Machine-Text Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for text a machine produced or will consume. Never for numbers, labels or decoration.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: If two things need separating, draw a rule between them. Never float a surface with a shadow.

dos: **Do** put every request on label stock inside a 2px Thermal Ink rule, with its routing number in condensed Archivo at weight 850.
**Do** show state as color, shape and word together: diamond orange, ring blue, square red, disc green, bar grey.
**Do** keep track stops at the same x in every row of a list.
**Do** separate with rules (2px structure, 1px hairline, dashed for not-yet) instead of shadows.
**Do** hold every target at 44px minimum and keep the 3px blue focus outline.
**Do** define every color as a custom property with a dark-theme counterpart.
donts: **Don't** use drop shadows or rounded cards; labels are square and flat.
**Don't** use a state color for decoration or a color without its shape and word.
**Don't** add a second type family; Archivo's width axis carries display, and monospace is only for machine text.
**Don't** use icon fonts or glyph icons; state marks and the plus are drawn in CSS.
**Don't** fall back to a grey admin list with a single blue accent and pill-shaped status badges.
